literal.prompt: Какой географический полюс Земли имеет широту 90° северной широты?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS factual: NOAA Latitude L5-L6,L28 explicitly maps90degrees north to geographic North Pole and90degrees south to South Pole. AAP defines geographic poles as rotation-axis intersections, distinct from magnetic poles. Only slot1 satisfies geographic90N. Magnetic dip90degrees in AAP is an angle of Earth magnetic field, not geographic latitude; no second key follows from that.

sourcesLocators.locator: Complete Latitude page L5-L6,L28; AAP axis/magnetic context below
HTML article headings True geographic pole/South magnetic pole/Geomagnetic pole

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.editorialGround: Current prompt explicitly asks which географический полюс. Both magnetic-labelled choices are a different class already excluded by that phrase. Among remaining two geographic pole labels, северной in prompt then directly selects Северный;90degree latitude does little work. This is concrete current wording/option interaction,not automatic disapproval of magnetic poles as distractors in any pole question. Same word полюс does not make four options plausibly responsive to this narrow condition. This is not an exact directreverse or a shared-template-only ruling. Current5 asks geographic pole at90N→North Pole; current6 asks point at90S→South Pole. NOAA L5-L6/L28 states both as one latitude endpoint convention. Once geographic pole is supplied in current5, no independent magnetic-position or rotational-property fact is needed; changing hemisphere applies the same single rule and swaps endpoint labels. Current6 already tests that coordinate-to-pole operation. Notes about Arctic Ocean vs Antarctica are not queried MAIN and do not establish new independent knowledge in current5.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Это Северный полюс. Географическая широта этой точки равна 90° северной, а сам полюс находится в центре Северного Ледовитого океана.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NOAA Latitude L28 explicitly gives90N North Pole; NOAA PMEL FAQ L142/L214 places North Pole in centre of Arctic Ocean. Current explanation names key and combines true coordinate/location facts, without old unproved direction wording.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Южный географический полюс находится на 90° южной широты в Антарктиде.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NOAA Latitude L28 explicitly gives90S at South Pole, and NOAA PMEL L214 explicitly locates it in middle of Antarctica. AAP True geographic pole describes same southern geographic point near Amundsen-Scott station. Both coordinate and continent claims about own South Pole are true.

sourcesLocators.locator: Full FAQ L214

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Географический Северный полюс находится в центре Северного Ледовитого океана, который почти со всех сторон окружён сушей.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NOAA PMEL FAQ L142 explicitly places North Pole in Arctic Ocean centre and lists surrounding Alaska/Canada/Greenland/Russia; L214 expressly contrasts ocean virtually surrounded by land with Antarctica’s continent surrounded by ocean. This location/land-configuration fact is independent extra beyond queried latitude90N,not only prompt/key repeat.

sourcesLocators.locator: Full FAQ L142,L214

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Магнитное направление на север обычно не совпадает с истинным севером; разницу между ними называют магнитным склонением.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: complete AAP Directions/Magnetic north paragraph says direction of magnetic pole is not usually parallel to meridian and names difference between true and magnetic north magnetic declination. Current note accurately keeps usually and correct angle term; it does not falsely identify magnetic pole as fixed90N.

sourcesLocators.locator: Complete HTML article Directions→Magnetic north

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Положение Южного магнитного полюса меняется; в 2020 году его координаты были 64,07° ю. ш. и 135,88° в. д.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: complete AAP South magnetic pole paragraph says it is not fixed and gives2020 location64.07degreesS,135.88degreesE. Current Russian64,07°ю.ш./135,88°в.д. are decimal degrees,not64°07minutes. Year2020 retained,not presented as2026 coordinates. No south geomagnetic80.65S/107.32E confusion.

sourceMetadataAssessment.finding: Exact source.url AAP Poles and directions explains geographic-axis poles and magnetic directions, but its90degree text is magnetic DIP,not a statement that North geographic latitude is90N. The complete retained NOAA Latitude page L28 directly states queried numeric relation. Full source bundle proves factual key, but user-facing primary hyperlink should directly substantiate MAIN rather than rely on another retained source for that exact numeric fact.
sourceMetadataAssessment.directedFix: If retaining latitude MAIN, use exact NOAA Latitude URL/title (https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/latitude.html); keep AAP dated magnetic/declination note evidence in audit. If MAIN is genuinely replaced for diversity, choose direct primary URL for resulting MAIN instead.
